_meta.description: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (free standard set), CC0. Mined from the owner's AshLane-prototype/public/motion/ual/ — the owner already pulled and licensed it.
_meta.fetch: GLBs are NOT copied into Western Heart (15 MB already live in the owner's public AshLane-prototype repo). The retarget pipeline fetches them at build time from the raw URLs below and enumerates clip names from each GLB's JSON chunk.
_meta.license: CC0 1.0 Universal. License text: AshLane-prototype/public/motion/ual/LICENSE.txt ("Quaternius Universal Animation Library, free standard set. CC0. https://quaternius.com/packs/universalanimationlibrary.html"). Keep this attribution with any redistribution.
_meta.rig: 65-joint Quaternius rig (pelvis, spine_01, upperarm_l, ...). Clips need NO retargeting on Quaternius bodies. Owner's retargetUal() (AshLane-prototype/src/game3d/motion-bank.ts) maps the 65-joint rig onto the 58-joint Mixamo skeleton (drops root + 12 leaf/end-effectors).

companion.modular_parts: AshLane-prototype/public/models/cast/quaternius/ — Superhero Male/Female full bodies + 9 hair/beard/eyebrow parts (CC0). Every part GLB carries the same 65-joint skeleton; attach by bone-name rebind (see AshLane-prototype/src/game3d/quaternius.ts: attachPart).
companion.part_attach_pattern: Match bone names between part and body, reuse the part's bind inverses, rebind against the body's live skeleton — no retargeting, no remap. The creation suite's part-attachment work should follow this pattern inside the existing parts pipeline.

files.note: Godot glTF+bin mirror of the same library; use the GLBs unless the pipeline prefers glTF.
